description: Water and sewer network length and equipment of the Miyahuna network is a series of data sets listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Jordan Water Company (Miyahuna). number of water subscriptions in Amman. Coverage: Jordan. The portal lists 6 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Jordan Water Company (Miyahuna). Its tags are Miyahuna, jordan water company, meter. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Jordonian License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
